meta.description: Repeated stratified group K-fold over the patient-balanced cohort. Folds are addressed by sample_id; positional indices are deliberately not stored.
meta.cohort_strategy_note: 'full' retains every patient and delegates the 1.4:1 class imbalance to class_weight='balanced' in the downstream classifiers; 'undersample' discards majority-class patients. The full cohort is the primary analysis because a measured learning curve (slope +0.000372 AUC per training image, p = 0.0145) showed the curve is not saturated, so discarded images were costing performance.
meta.inner_split_purpose: inner_cal is reserved exclusively for decision-threshold calibration and hyper-parameter selection; it is never used to report metrics.
meta.inner_folds_note: Each fold carries an 'inner_folds' list with all 4 inner train/calibration partitions. Phases 3 and 4 average the decision threshold over them to reduce its variance. The flat 'inner_train'/'inner_cal' keys hold the first partition and are retained for backward compatibility.
